title: Equilibria and linear stability for the Boltzmann equation with radial anharmonic confining potentials
summary: We study the Boltzmann equation in the whole space under the radial anharmonic confining potentials $Φ(x)=|x|^p/p$ for $p>2$ and $Φ(x)=\langle x\rangle^p/p$ for $1 2$, the nonlinear equilibrium manifold is parametrized by mass, temperature, and the three components of angular momentum; for $1<p<2$, integrability excludes rotating equilibria and only mass and energy remain as equilibrium parameters. We then identify the five-dimensional stationary space of the equation linearized about an arbitrary equilibrium and construct an explicit projection determined by the conserved moments. After…
